TASK BRIEF: Create a customer support ticket (HubSpot CRM API)

FIT
  Partially. The supplied request can create a support ticket, but no supplied request updates an existing ticket, so the full create-and-update goal cannot be completed. All supplied requests serve the task.

AUTH
  Bearer authentication
  Supply the HubSpot access token as a Bearer credential; the exact credential value is not provided.

BASE URL
  https://api.hubapi.com

STEPS
  1. POST /crm/v3/objects/tickets
     Params:
       Content-Type: header — 'application/json'
       Accept: header — 'application/json'
       Request body: the request schema does not specify a body or ticket property fields.
     Returns:
       201 Created with a JSON object containing createdAt (date-time), id (string), properties (object), updatedAt (date-time), propertiesWithHistory (object), archived (boolean), and archivedAt (date-time). Error examples also show category, correlationId, message, errors (array), context (object), links (object), and subCategory fields.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Replace {{baseUrl}} with https://api.hubapi.com.
  - Send the request as JSON and include both Content-Type and Accept headers as shown.
  - The supplied request does not define the JSON body or required ticket properties; obtain the ticket-field requirements separately rather than inventing them.
  - The returned id identifies the created ticket, but no supplied update endpoint is available for using it to modify the ticket.
  - A Bearer token is required, but no token value is included.
